newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EUROPEAN FEEDS SEE SOME TRADES AFTER USDA DATA.
newsitem.headline: EUROPEAN FEEDS SEE SOME TRADES AFTER USDA DATA.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw a few trades in Argentine soymeal pellets at easier levels after USDA put the 97/98 U.S. soybean crop at a record 2.744 bln bushels, market sources said.

"The soybean crop figure was seen bearish. We saw a few nearby trades, but it was not much. Most buyers decided to stay off the market waiting how Chicago soymeal futures would end today after they opened unexpectedly higher," one broker said.
Afloat and August Argentine soymeal pellets both changed hands at $253 a tonne cif Rotterdam, $3 under sellers' ideas and Sept at at $249 a tonne cif.
Sept Dutch high protein soymeal traded at $283 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
EU rapemeal changed hands at 21.50 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine for August delivery. No trades were reported in other products.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832.
